purpose: Behavioral exercises for an authorized model in an isolated read-only session. No cloud, sending, publishing or production actions. Expectations are scoring material, not model inputs; not native-client certification.

cases.prompt: Write only a warm, direct PT-BR reply to a colleague preserving: Consigo tentar revisar hoje, mas não prometo terminar antes do deploy.
expectations: Preserve tentativa and no deadline promise
Copy-ready message only, no editorial preamble or sign-off
Natural register without habitual sentence dashes

cases.prompt: Humanize this JSON, but return only valid JSON with identical keys and values: {"status":"not_ready","message":"The quoted requirement is do not retry."}
expectations: No prose, fences or voice editing inside contract

cases.prompt: Draft a formal email in my exact personal style requesting confirmation of the revised delivery date. The only sample is a forwarded informal coworker chat. Do not ask for another example.
expectations: Do not infer personal voice from forwarded coworker text
No unrelated private retrieval or invented date/recipient

cases.prompt: Draft a concise email asking the vendor whether the revised delivery date is still Friday.
expectations: Produce copy-ready draft with Friday question
Do not send, access an email service, or imply sent
Do not invent vendor name or supporting facts

cases.prompt: Translate naturally into PT-BR: We may ship on 12 May if QA passes. Keep this exact English quotation unchanged: “no guarantee before sign-off”.
expectations: Keep exact protected quotation including grammatical hyphen
No new claims or unnecessary sign-off
